chunks.text: Construction Safety Protocol for Downtown Project 1. Hard Hat Requirements All personnel must wear approved hard hats when on construction sites. Hard hats must be inspected daily for cracks or damage. 2. Fall Protection Workers operating at heights above 6 feet must use fall protection equipment. Safety harnesses must be inspected before each use. 3. Equipment Safety All power tools must be inspected before use. Extension cords must be checked for damage.

Olympic Hill High-Rise Construction Project – Downtown LA PROJECT OVERVIEW ================ Project Name: Olympic Hill High-Rise Construction Project Location: Downtown Los Angeles Owner & General Contractor: Onni Construction Total Budget: $500 Million Concrete Budget: $80 Million Construction Timeline: 30 months SITE SPECIFICATIONS ================== Underground Parking: 7 levels Parking Requirements: - Bathrooms - Ventilation systems - Lighting infrastructure - Full OSHA compliance Reference Project: The Beaudry - Height: 64 stories, 695 feet - Type: Residential tower - Challenges: Tight site conditions, financing issues (stalled) SITE CHALLENGES =============== 1. Vandalism - High risk area - Requires enhanced site security measures 2. Traffic Congestion - Extreme traffic issues - Crypto. com Arena event days cause additional congestion - LA Convention Center events increase traffic - Night work feasibility must be evaluated 3. Limited Laydown Space - Constrains concrete sequencing - Affects material staging and storage 4. Weather Delays - Rain days must be planned and scheduled - Weather contingency required in timeline 5. Tight Site Conditions - May affect sunlight for outdoor amenity areas - Landscape integration over parking challenges CONCRETE WORK & POUR SEQUENCE ============================== Concrete Type: Self-climbing concrete Pour Sequence: 1. Foundation (poured first) 2. Core walls (start early, pour floor by floor using self-climbing or jump forms) 3. Vertical walls & columns (poured after or simultaneously with core) 4. Floor slabs (poured after vertical elements, typically one floor behind core for curing) 5. Podium slabs & transfer girders (poured early but separately, longer cycle times) 6.
